title: repro crash in Administrator: File Locksmith

judgment.rationale: This report provides an administrator-mode File Locksmith crash and access-violation signature on 0.102.2933.0. The same handle-enumeration worker-lifetime crash is already tracked in #49789 and addressed by the open proposal in PR #49966. The new report adds useful reproduction evidence, but not a separate confirmed code path. PR #49966 is unmerged and its latest review identifies unresolved worker-lifetime/cancellation concerns; the crash is not considered fixed.
judgment.recommended_action: Consolidate the administrator-mode reproduction and crash signature into #49789, keep that issue as the single tracker, and resolve the outstanding review findings on #49966 before treating the behavior as covered.
evidence: The live issue body reports File Locksmith 0.102.2933.0, a failure after restarting as administrator, and an access violation in FileLocksmithLib.Interop.dll.
The reporter attached a diagnostic archive; inspected File Locksmith UI logs show startup with one selected file but do not identify the failing stack or operation.
Upstream #49789 tracks a File Locksmith handle-enumeration crash on the same release; its existing issue artifact remains needs_information and does not mark author wait.
Upstream PR #49966 is open and unmerged; its current review artifact requests changes and its review notes unresolved worker-lifetime concerns.

fix_assessment.rationale: The concrete in-progress coverage is upstream PR #49966 for the same underlying handle-enumeration worker-lifetime defect. This is not a merged or verified fix: the PR remains open/unmerged and its current review identifies unresolved lifetime/cancellation gaps. Do not mark the reported crash resolved or open a competing fix.

issue_context.summary: The reporter says File Locksmith in PowerToys 0.102.2933.0 crashes after restarting as administrator and provides an access-violation signature plus a diagnostic archive.
known_information: PowerToys release is 0.102.2933.0 stable; installation method is auto-update.
The affected module is File Locksmith; the reported failure occurs after using Restart as Administrator.
The issue body identifies an access violation in PowerToys.FileLocksmithLib.Interop.dll and includes a bug-report archive.
The inspected File Locksmith UI log records startup with one file selected but does not show the specific failing operation or stack.
Upstream issue #49789 and open PR #49966 already cover the same handle-enumeration worker-lifetime crash area.
inferences: This is likely additional evidence for #49789 rather than an independent defect because the module, crash family, and affected code area align; the issue evidence does not prove an identical call path.
The attached UI log alone cannot establish whether administrator elevation or the underlying handle enumeration triggers the crash.
issue_context.analysis: The new report has a specific version, action sequence, module, exception signature, and attached diagnostic archive, so another generic log request would be redundant. The archive UI log ends at startup/selection and does not establish a stack or precise failing operation. Repository history and the existing PR show the same worker-lifetime area is under active review, not shipped. Consolidate this evidence into #49789 without proposing a competing implementation or claiming resolution.
initial_investigation: Read the current issue body, labels, full discussion (no comments), and attachment reference; confirmed the report is open and has Issue-Bug and Needs-Triage labels.
Inspected the reporter-provided archive privately; the relevant UI log shows startup with one selected file and no diagnostic failure detail.
Reviewed upstream #49789 and current canonical issue artifact: it is still an open triage item with an outstanding information request, not author-wait.
Reviewed upstream PR #49966 and its current fork review trace: open/unmerged, with requested changes and identified worker lifetime/cancellation gaps.
Checked current upstream NtdllExtensions.cpp history; latest source commit is cfdb1d7af58a and the touched worker path predates this report.

actions.label: Link this report to the existing File Locksmith crash investigation

comment.body: Thanks for the detailed report and the attached diagnostic archive. This appears to belong with the existing File Locksmith handle-enumeration crash investigation in #49789; please have maintainers carry this administrator-mode reproduction and the reported access-violation signature into that issue rather than start a parallel fix. PR #49966 is still open and unmerged, and its latest review discussion identifies unresolved worker-lifetime concerns, so it should not be treated as a shipped or verified fix.
